componentContracts.purpose: Orient the audience and expose the small governed set of property, route, and page destinations.
componentContracts.nonPurpose: It is not a generic link inventory, action toolbar, or substitute for page evidence.
componentContracts.contentContract: Use exact locale-complete destination labels, one page current and one location current where interactive, and no workflow labels.

default.behavior: Direct destinations and brand identity are readable and operable.

hover.behavior: Pointer hover adds emphasis without changing target, label, or geometry.

focus.behavior: A visible focus indicator identifies the direct semantic target.

activePressed.behavior: Pressed feedback does not move, shrink, or proxy the target.

selectedCurrent.behavior: Page and location currents use scoped semantics and more than color alone.

disabled.behavior: Navigation destinations are omitted when unavailable rather than shown as disabled mysteries.

loading.behavior: The navigation shell does not imply unresolved destinations while loading.

empty.behavior: An empty local index is omitted without leaving a rail or trigger.

error.behavior: A route failure preserves the current page, label, and a recoverable destination.

success.behavior: Successful navigation exposes the new scoped current state and heading target.

formatBehavior.behavior: Semantic site navigation plus optional page-local side bookmark and mobile disclosure.

accessibility.name: Every destination and disclosure has an exact locale-specific accessible name.
accessibility.role: Links remain links; the disclosure trigger remains a button; the container remains navigation.
accessibility.value: Expanded and scoped current states are programmatically exposed only when interactive.
accessibility.order: Brand, current page, primary task, language/access, then lower-priority disclosure.
accessibility.status: Route change, disclosure change, and deep-link arrival preserve perceivable context.

componentContracts.evidencePermissionBoundary: Navigation labels and destinations expose approved audience truth and never imply evidence or execution authority.
antiPatterns: More than the governed direct-control budget

componentContracts.purpose: Expose overflow destinations through one predictable button-controlled disclosure.
componentContracts.nonPurpose: It is not an application menu, focus trap, or replacement for direct primary destinations.
componentContracts.contentContract: The trigger has locale-complete name, accurate expanded state, and grouped destination labels.

default.behavior: Trigger is closed, named, and operable.

hover.behavior: Hover emphasizes the same direct trigger.

focus.behavior: Visible focus remains on trigger or the next logical disclosed item.

activePressed.behavior: Activation toggles once and synchronizes expanded state.

selectedCurrent.behavior: Current destination remains scoped inside the disclosed links.

loading.behavior: Governed destinations exist before disclosure is emitted.

empty.behavior: No trigger is rendered when there are no overflow destinations.

error.behavior: Disclosure itself has no remote error state.

success.behavior: Open or closed is state, not success.

accessibility.name: Exact locale trigger name.
accessibility.role: Button controls a disclosed region; destinations remain links.
accessibility.order: Trigger precedes disclosed content in logical order.
accessibility.status: Open and close preserve predictable focus.

componentContracts.evidencePermissionBoundary: Disclosure reveals approved destinations only and grants no action authority.
antiPatterns: Menu role without menu keyboard model

componentContracts.purpose: Keep stable page sections findable and expose current location on long content.
componentContracts.nonPurpose: It is not global navigation or a decorative rail.
componentContracts.contentContract: Selected only with recorded user benefit and at least two real locale-labelled heading anchors.

default.behavior: Stable anchors remain readable and operable.

hover.behavior: Hover does not alter anchor or target geometry.

activePressed.behavior: Activation lands once on the visible heading.

selectedCurrent.behavior: Exactly one live location uses programmatic current plus non-color cue.

loading.behavior: Anchors exist before the bookmark is selected.

empty.behavior: The rail is omitted when fewer than two useful anchors remain.

error.behavior: Broken anchors fail validation rather than becoming a visible state.

success.behavior: Current location is not a success state.

formatBehavior.behavior: Side rail degrading to mobile disclosure.

accessibility.name: Local index has a locale-specific name.
accessibility.value: Current location is programmatic only when interactive.
accessibility.status: Deep-link arrival remains visible and focused predictably.

componentContracts.evidencePermissionBoundary: Bookmark orientation never changes claim scope or permission.

componentContracts.purpose: Expose one truthful navigational destination with a complete locale label and no simulated state change.
componentContracts.nonPurpose: It does not submit, mutate, load, report success, own recovery, or imitate an unavailable control.
componentContracts.contentContract: Bind one complete verb-led locale label to one real route, anchor, external URL, download, contact path, or truthful static destination cue.

default.behavior: The complete label and truthful outcome are immediately readable.

hover.behavior: Pointer hover adds finite emphasis without changing meaning or geometry.

focus.behavior: Visible focus remains on the direct action element.

activePressed.behavior: Pressed feedback is finite and fires the governed outcome at most once.

selectedCurrent.behavior: A CTA does not masquerade as a navigation current-state control.

disabled.behavior: An unavailable destination is omitted; a navigational link does not expose a disabled state.

loading.behavior: Navigation begins on activation; this anchor has no in-control loading state.

empty.behavior: The resolved anchor exists before this CTA is emitted.

error.behavior: This component does not own destination error UI; route-level recovery is separate.

success.behavior: Arrival is represented by the destination current state, not a CTA success state.

formatBehavior.behavior: A direct link or button with one real destination or outcome.

accessibility.name: The accessible name equals the complete locale label.
accessibility.role: Use one ordinary link with the exact destination.
accessibility.value: No busy, progress, success, error, permission, or receipt state belongs to a navigational CTA.
accessibility.order: The primary action follows its decision context and precedes lower-priority actions.
accessibility.status: Destination availability and failure recovery belong to the route or document context, not this CTA.

componentContracts.evidencePermissionBoundary: The CTA may act only within its declared consequence and permission contracts and must not imply unsupported evidence.
antiPatterns: Completion implied before a terminal result
